TASK BRIEF: List on-prem managed agents for a customer workspace (Workato)

FIT
  Fully. The supplied request lists all on-prem agents in a managed customer workspace, matching the goal of retrieving managed agents. No requests were dropped.

AUTH
  Bearer token authentication.
  Header: Authorization: Bearer <api_token>

BASE URL
  https://www.workato.com

STEPS
  1. GET /api/v2/managed_users/{managedUserId}/on_prem_agents
     Params:
       managedUserId: string — 'managed-user-id-here'; place in the URL path. For an external customer ID, URL-encode it and prefix it with 'E'.
       Accept: string — 'application/json'; place in the request header.
     Returns:
       200 OK with a JSON object containing a data array. Each agent object may include id (number), name (string), os (string), installation_method, awaiting_setup (boolean), enabled (boolean), last_seen_version, created_at and updated_at (timestamps), state (string), activated (boolean), cn (string), and on_prem_group_id (number).
     Threading:
       None

GOTCHAS
  - Use the full path under https://www.workato.com; do not include /api in the base URL twice.
  - The customer identifier is a path variable, not a query parameter. External IDs must be URL-encoded and prefixed with 'E'.
  - Supply the bearer token in the Authorization header and request JSON with Accept: application/json.
  - This Embedded API requires the appropriate Workato Embedded feature and partner/customer permissions.
  - On-prem endpoints are rate-limited to 60 requests per minute; handle 401, 404, and 429 responses appropriately.
